title: L2 ten-item comparison light concentration cap

rule.base_sampling: uniform without replacement from the existing L2 comparison pool
rule.repair: If the first uniform ten contains more than two identity items, keep two and replace the extras with unused non-identity candidates.

rationale: Uniform L2 sampling is broadly acceptable and should remain the default.
Only the 13-item identity family creates a noticeable clustering risk.
A two-item cap cuts visible repetition without imposing artificial source quotas.
invariants: Exactly ten unique items when at least ten candidates exist.
No inventory or layer metadata changes.
L1 uses v0.86.1 stratified comparison and is unaffected.
The cap is based on semantic family metadata, not string matching.
